title: Choose the design system for the new Dapper website
question: Colours come from Delta, every word and photo from Dapper. The roll dealt the Livery system; keep it, take the inspection report, or re-roll.

options.label: Livery
options.lineage: endurance-racing liveries and race-car number roundels
options.thesis: The website is painted like a race car: Delta red and black livery bands cut across every page, sponsor-decal plates, and a numbered roundel for each step.
options.viewport: A real Dapper photo cut on a diagonal, red and black livery bands sweeping across under a huge condensed headline, the partners as decals, Book as the red band's end.
options.risk: Racing clichés (checkered flags, speed lines) creep in unless the bands stay the only device.

raised.raise: Photos carry leader-line callouts pinned to the panel they describe, like force labels on a sculpture.
Every label plate sits square on one grid, stencilled, the way crates are marked.
One car held at a time: each section focuses on a single real vehicle, never a collage.
The livery bands run continuously across section joins, so the page reads as one painted body with no seams.

options.label: Inspection Report
options.lineage: a detailer's vehicle inspection and paint-depth report
options.thesis: Every page is a care report on a real car: panels pinned with what was done, measured and returned.
options.viewport: A real car on a dark report sheet, red leader lines pinning Paint, Glass and Cabin to what was done, the headline below, Book at the corner.
options.risk: Can feel technical and cold; it needs real photos and warm testimonials to stay human.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.kept: Leader-line callouts pinned to what they describe.

options.label: Industrial Quotes
options.kept: Label plates square on one grid.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: One event held at a time.
options.kept: One car held at a time.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark car photo, big headline, red pill button.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every detailer, including Delta.
